name: Apollo 11
description: The first crewed mission to land astronauts on the Moon and return them safely to Earth.

name: Voyager 1
description: A robotic probe studying the outer Solar System and the space beyond the Sun's heliosphere.

name: Mars 2020 Perseverance
description: A rover exploring Jezero Crater, studying ancient Martian environments, and collecting rock samples.

name: James Webb Space Telescope
description: An infrared space observatory studying the early universe, distant galaxies, stars, and exoplanets.

name: Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer (JUICE)
description: A spacecraft traveling to Jupiter to study Ganymede, Callisto, Europa, and the Jovian system.
